text:
Predicates:
Winner(x, y) ::: x is the winner of y.
Participated(x, y) ::: x participated in y.
TieGroup(x) ::: x is a group of tied players.
FromBelgium(x) ::: x is from Belgium.
OnLeaderboard(x, y) ::: x is on the leaderboard of y.
Person(x) ::: x is a person.
Year(y) ::: y is a year.

Premises:
Winner(Steinhauer, duMaurier1992) ::: Steinhauer was the winner of the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
Participated(Steinhauer, duMaurier1992) ::: Steinhauer participated in the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
∃x (TieGroup(x) ∧ ∃y (Member(y, x) ∧ Person(y))) ::: There was a six-way tie on the leaderboard.
∃x (TieGroup(x) ∧ ∃y (Member(y, x) ∧ FromBelgium(y))) ::: One person in the six-way tie was from Belgium.
FromBelgium(Descampe) ::: Descampe is from Belgium.
Member(Descampe, x) ::: Descampe is a member of the tie group x.
OnLeaderboard(Descampe, duMaurier1992) ::: Descampe is on the leaderboard.
∀x (OnLeaderboard(x, duMaurier1992) → Participated(x, duMaurier1992)) ::: All people on the leaderboard participated in the tournament.

Conclusion:
¬Winner(Steinhauer, duMaurier1992) ::: Steinhauer was not the winner of the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
